claims: SpaceX successfully launched a Falcon 9 rocket carrying 25 Starlink satellites from Vandenberg Space Force Base.
The launch took place on Monday, April 6, 2026.
The launch took place at 7:50 p.m. PDT.
The Starlink 17-35 mission featured a first-stage booster landing on the drone ship 'Of Course I Still Love You'.
No further launches are listed for April 7.
The launch location was Space Launch Complex 4 East (SLC-4E).
